passages.text:

passages.title: North lot closure
passages.text:

why.vi: "Due to resurfacing".
why.en: The notice gives resurfacing as the reason.

questions.q: How can visitors get free parking in the Elm Street garage?

why.vi: "free for the first two hours with a validation stamp from the library desk".
why.en: A validation stamp from the library desk makes the first two hours free.

passages.text:

passages.text:

passages.title: Kitchen messages
passages.text:
Hana Cole (11:32 A.M.): Chef, the produce supplier called. Tomorrow's tomato delivery will be late.
Marco Bianchi (11:33 A.M.): How late?
Hana Cole (11:34 A.M.): After 2:00 P.M. A truck broke down.
Marco Bianchi (11:36 A.M.): That's after lunch service. We'll have to change the soup special.
Hana Cole (11:37 A.M.): Should I tell the servers?
Marco Bianchi (11:38 A.M.): Not yet. I need to check what we have in the freezer first. I'll let you know by 4.
Hana Cole (11:39 A.M.): Understood. I'll hold off.

questions.q: What is the problem?

why.vi: "Tomorrow's tomato delivery will be late."
why.en: Ms. Cole says the tomato delivery will be late.

questions.q: At 11:39 A.M., what does Ms. Cole mean when she writes, "I'll hold off"?
options: She will wait to tell the servers
She will stop working for now
She will call the supplier again

why.vi: Chef vừa nói "Not yet" khi cô hỏi có báo cho nhân viên phục vụ không; "hold off" là chờ.
why.en: The chef said "Not yet" about telling the servers, so she will wait.

questions.q: What will Chef Bianchi probably do next?

why.vi: Anh nói cần "check what we have in the freezer first".
why.en: He says he needs to check what is in the freezer first.

passages.title: Electric ferries on trial
passages.text:
PORTLAND (April 9) - The city's transit authority will test two electric ferries on the Harbor route beginning in March, officials announced Tuesday. The boats, built by Nordvik Marine, will replace diesel ferries that are now 25 years old.

Each new ferry carries 120 passengers and can travel 40 kilometers on a single charge. Crews will recharge the boats at the terminal during breaks. Fares will stay at $4 per trip during the six-month trial.

"We expect noise and fuel costs to fall significantly," said transit director Alan Reeve. If the trial is successful, the authority will order four more boats, funded by a state environmental grant.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?

why.vi: Cả bài nói về việc thử nghiệm hai phà chạy điện.
why.en: The article reports a trial of two electric ferries.

questions.q: What will happen to fares during the trial?
options: They will be reduced by half

why.vi: "Fares will stay at $4 per trip".
why.en: Fares will stay at $4 per trip.

questions.q: What is implied about the electric ferries?
options: They are slower than diesel ferries
They must be recharged during the day
They carry more passengers than old ferries
They are built by the transit authority

why.vi: Một lần sạc chạy 40 km, và nhân viên sẽ sạc ở bến "during breaks", nên cần sạc giữa ngày.
why.en: One charge covers 40 km and crews recharge at the terminal during breaks, so recharging is needed during the day.

questions.trap: Bài không so sánh tốc độ hay sức chở với phà cũ.

passages.title: Letter from hotel
passages.text:
Lakeview Hotel
15 Shore Drive

June 12

Ms. Rita Alvarez
310 Pine Street

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

Thank you for your letter of June 3 regarding your recent stay. I am sorry that the air conditioning in Room 412 did not work during your visit. Our engineers have since repaired the unit.

As a gesture of goodwill, I have credited your account with the cost of one night ($140). I have also enclosed a voucher for a free breakfast for two, valid until December 31.

I hope to welcome you back soon.

Sincerely,
Martin Osei
General Manager

questions.q: Why did Mr. Osei write the letter?

why.vi: Ông xin lỗi vì máy lạnh phòng 412 không hoạt động.
why.en: He apologizes for the air conditioning that did not work.

questions.q: What has been credited to Ms. Alvarez's account?

why.vi: "credited your account with the cost of one night ($140)".
why.en: The letter says one night, $140, has been credited.

questions.trap: Bữa sáng miễn phí là phiếu đính kèm, không phải khoản ghi có vào tài khoản.

questions.q: The word "valid" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to

why.vi: "Valid until December 31": phiếu dùng được đến hết ngày đó.
why.en: A voucher that is valid until a date can be used until that date.

passages.title: Visitor badge procedure
passages.text:
MEMO
To: All employees
From: Security Office
Date: June 4
Re: New visitor badge procedure

Effective June 16, all visitors must be registered at the front desk before entering the building. [1] Employees expecting visitors should send the guest's name and arrival time to the Security Office by 4:00 P.M. on the previous day. [2] Visitors will be given a color-coded badge showing the floor they are allowed to visit. [3] Badges must be returned to the front desk when the visitor leaves. [4]

Employees who do not follow this procedure may lose the right to host visitors. Questions should be directed to Helen Ito at extension 318.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To announce a security guard's retirement
To describe a new visitor procedure

why.vi: Tiêu đề: "New visitor badge procedure".
why.en: The subject line announces a new visitor badge procedure.

questions.q: What should employees do by 4:00 P.M. on the day before a visit?
options: Meet the visitor at the front desk
Send the visitor's details to Security

why.vi: "send the guest's name and arrival time to the Security Office by 4:00 P.M."
why.en: Employees must send the guest's name and arrival time to Security.

questions.q: What is NOT required of visitors?

why.vi: Bản ghi nhớ không đề cập đến giấy tờ tùy thân có ảnh.
why.en: Photo identification is not mentioned anywhere in the memo.

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"This allows the front desk to prepare badges in advance."

why.vi: "This" chỉ việc gửi trước tên và giờ đến ở câu liền trước, nên câu đứng tại [2].
why.en: "This" refers to sending the guest's details the day before, so the sentence belongs at [2].

questions.trap: Ở [3] hoặc [4], "This" sẽ chỉ huy hiệu hoặc việc trả huy hiệu, không hợp nghĩa chuẩn bị trước.

passages.title: Lakeside Conference Center
passages.text:
Lakeside Conference Center | Room Rental

Cypress Room: up to 20 people, $120 per hour
Maple Hall: up to 60 people, $250 per hour
Grand Ballroom: up to 200 people, $600 per hour

Minimum rental: two hours. Wi-Fi, a projector, and a whiteboard are included at no extra charge.

Catering is available through Table & Fork. Orders for 30 or more guests must be placed at least five days in advance.

Cancellations: free up to 14 days before the event; 50 percent of the rental fee from 7 to 13 days before; no refund within 6 days.

Book online and receive 5 percent off the rental fee.

questions.q: What is included in the rental price?

why.vi: "Wi-Fi, a projector, and a whiteboard are included at no extra charge."
why.en: Wi-Fi, a projector, and a whiteboard are included.

questions.q: How much would a three-hour meeting for 45 people cost in the cheapest suitable room, booked online?

why.vi: 45 người cần Maple Hall: 3 x $250 = $750; đặt trực tuyến giảm 5% còn $712.50.
why.en: Maple Hall costs 3 x $250 = $750, and 5 percent off for online booking gives $712.50.

questions.trap: Cypress Room chỉ chứa 20 người; $750 là chưa trừ giảm giá 5%.

questions.q: What will happen if a customer cancels 10 days before the event?
options: The customer will pay half of the rental fee
The customer will pay the full fee
The customer must rebook within a week

why.vi: 10 ngày nằm trong khoảng 7 đến 13 ngày, bị tính 50% phí thuê.
why.en: Ten days falls between 7 and 13 days, so 50 percent of the fee is charged.

questions.q: What is suggested about catering for large groups?
options: It is only for the Grand Ballroom
It is included in room prices
It needs to be arranged early

why.vi: Đơn từ 30 khách trở lên phải đặt trước ít nhất năm ngày.
why.en: Orders for 30 or more guests must be placed at least five days ahead.

passages.title: Warehouse messages
passages.text:
Abel Torres (1:02 P.M.): Has anyone seen the pallet for Customer 8812? It's not at Dock 3.

questions.q: Where is the pallet for Customer 8812?

why.vi: "I moved it to Dock 5 this morning."
why.en: Ms. Chen says she moved it to Dock 5.

questions.q: At 1:08 P.M., what does Mr. Torres mean when he writes, "On it"?
options: He will tell the driver to go to Dock 5
He is standing on the pallet

why.vi: Ông Okoye vừa bảo "tell the driver to pull around to Dock 5", và "On it" là anh nhận làm việc đó.
why.en: Mr. Okoye asked him to tell the driver to move to Dock 5, and "On it" means he will do it.

why.en: He will hold the truck until the photo is sent, which he considers a sensible precaution.

questions.q: Why is Mr. Okoye concerned about the torn box?

why.en: He notes that the customer is picky about packaging.

passages.title: Library extends hours
passages.text:
WESTBROOK (July 8) - Westbrook Public Library will extend its evening hours starting August 1, after a survey in which 62 percent of residents asked for later opening times. The library will now close at 9:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday instead of 7:00 P.M. Friday and Saturday hours remain 10:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M.

The change will be paid for by a donation from the Westbrook Business Association, which covers costs for one year. Two part-time clerks will be hired and staffing will be adjusted. "Many people work until 6:00 and could never visit," said librarian Fiona Walsh. A review next July will decide whether the longer hours continue.

passages.title: Longer hours
passages.text:
To: Fiona Walsh
From: Ben Adeyemi
Date: July 12
Subject: Longer hours

Dear Ms. Walsh,

I read about the extended hours with great interest. I teach until 6:30 P.M. on weekdays and have never been able to visit before. I would like to ask the library to consider opening on Friday evenings as well.

Sincerely,
Ben Adeyemi

questions.q: Why is the library extending its hours?

why.vi: "after a survey in which 62 percent of residents asked for later opening times".
why.en: A survey showed most residents wanted later hours.

questions.q: What does Mr. Adeyemi ask the library to do?

why.vi: "consider opening on Friday evenings as well".
why.en: He asks the library to consider opening on Friday evenings.

questions.q: How long will the donation cover the extra hours?

why.vi: "which covers costs for one year".
why.en: The donation covers costs for one year.

questions.q: On which weekday can Mr. Adeyemi still NOT visit after work?

why.vi: Ông dạy đến 6:30 tối; thư viện mở đến 9 giờ tối thứ Hai đến thứ Năm nhưng thứ Sáu đóng cửa lúc 5 giờ chiều.
why.en: He finishes at 6:30 P.M.; the library is open until 9:00 P.M. Monday to Thursday but closes at 5:00 P.M. on Friday.

questions.q: The word "adjusted" in paragraph 2 of the article is closest in meaning to

why.vi: "Staffing will be adjusted" nghĩa là nhân sự được điều chỉnh, thay đổi.
why.en: Adjusting staffing means changing it to fit the new hours.

passages.text:

questions.q: Why did Mr. Petrov write the e-mail?

why.vi: "Could you send us a quote?"

questions.q: Why will Mr. Petrov probably pay a delivery charge?

questions.q: The word "guarantee" in the third e-mail is closest in meaning to

why.vi: "Confirm ... to guarantee your date" nghĩa là để chắc chắn giữ được ngày.
why.en: Confirming is done to ensure the date is kept.

questions.trap: "Promise" nghe gần nhưng không đi với tân ngữ "date" theo nghĩa bảo đảm giữ chỗ.

passages.title: Remote work policy
passages.text:
MEMO
To: All employees
From: Human Resources
Date: December 15
Re: Remote work policy

Effective January 5, employees may work from home up to two days per week with their supervisor's approval. Requests must be submitted on the Remote Work Request Form at least five working days before the first remote day. Employees in their first six months of employment are not eligible. Meetings that require in-person attendance take priority over remote work.

passages.title: Remote Work Request Form
passages.text:
REMOTE WORK REQUEST FORM

Employee: Samira Khan
Department: Accounting
Hire date: July 1, last year
Requested remote days: Mondays and Fridays
First remote day: Monday, January 12
Date submitted: Friday, January 2

passages.title: Your request
passages.text:
To: Samira Khan
From: Peter Walsh, Accounting Supervisor
Date: January 5
Subject: Your request

Dear Samira,

I have reviewed your request. I can approve Fridays now, but Mondays are when our team holds in-person budget meetings. Could you suggest a different second day?

Peter Walsh

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To explain a new remote work policy

why.vi: Tiêu đề: "Remote work policy".
why.en: The subject line announces a remote work policy.

questions.q: Why is Ms. Khan eligible for remote work?
options: She has worked there more than six months

why.vi: Ngày vào làm 1/7 năm ngoái nên đến tháng 1 đã quá sáu tháng.
why.en: She was hired July 1 of last year, so she has passed the six-month limit.

questions.q: What is indicated about Ms. Khan's form?

why.vi: Cần nộp ít nhất 5 ngày làm việc trước ngày 12/1; nộp ngày 2/1 là kịp (hạn là 5/1).
why.en: The form needed to be in five working days before January 12, and January 2 meets that.

questions.trap: Cô đề nghị hai ngày, không phải ba.

questions.q: Which day will Mr. Walsh probably not approve?

why.vi: Chính sách ưu tiên họp trực tiếp, và thứ Hai là ngày họp ngân sách trực tiếp.
why.en: In-person meetings take priority, and Mondays are budget meeting days.

questions.trap: Thứ Sáu thì ông đồng ý ngay.

questions.q: What does Mr. Walsh ask Ms. Khan to do?

why.vi: "Could you suggest a different second day?"
why.en: He asks her to suggest a different second day.

passages.title: Support chat
passages.text:

passages.title: Return policy
passages.text:
RETURN POLICY
Damaged or defective items may be exchanged or refunded within 14 days of delivery. Send photos of the damage to the returns team. We provide a prepaid return label for defective items. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the returned item.
Items that are not defective may be returned within 30 days for a refund minus an $8 restocking fee.

passages.title: Your return
passages.text:
To: Luis Ortega
From: Dana Wu

Subject: Your return

Thank you for the photos. I have approved a refund for your blender ($64.99) and attached a prepaid return label. Please ship the blender back within seven days.

Dana Wu

questions.q: What problem does Mr. Ortega report?

why.vi: "the lid is cracked".
why.en: He says the lid of the blender is cracked.

questions.q: What did Ms. Wu ask Mr. Ortega to send?

why.vi: "Please send photos of the lid".
why.en: She asks him to send photos of the lid.

questions.trap: Số đơn hàng là việc cô hỏi ở dòng trước và anh đã đưa.

questions.q: Why was Mr. Ortega given a prepaid return label?

why.vi: Chính sách: nhãn trả hàng trả trước dành cho hàng lỗi, và nắp bị nứt là lỗi.
why.en: The policy provides prepaid labels for defective items, and the cracked lid is a defect.

questions.q: What must happen before Mr. Ortega receives his refund?
options: He must pay a restocking fee
The blender must reach the company

why.vi: Hoàn tiền được cấp trong 5 đến 7 ngày làm việc sau khi công ty nhận lại hàng.
why.en: Refunds are issued within 5 to 7 business days after the company receives the returned item.

questions.q: What is implied about the restocking fee?

why.en: The $8 fee applies only to non-defective items, and his blender is defective.
